resources.string: Connect the app to your VylarisCloud server.
Format ABCD-EFGH. Create a code in the panel under \"Connected devices\". Without a code you simply sign in on the website as usual.
That is not a valid address.
Only https:// addresses (or http:// on the local network) are possible.
Please enter the address without username and password.
Warning: http:// is unencrypted and only allowed for addresses on the local network (e.g. 192.168.x.x). I have inserted https:// instead, please check the address.
The pairing code has 8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH.
The server cannot be reached. Check the address and your internet connection. (%1$s)
No VylarisCloud server is running at this address.
The pairing code is unknown, expired or has already been used.
Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
This device could not store the token securely. You will have to sign in on the web.
Connect this device to %1$s? Only confirm if you created this link yourself in your VylarisCloud.
The server redirects to a different address: %1$s. Enter that address yourself if you trust it.
You are connected to %1$s. Connect to %2$s and replace the current connection?
The page could not be loaded. Check your internet connection.
The server\'s security certificate is not trusted. The connection was cancelled for your safety.
No app is installed for this.
Unencrypted connections are only allowed on the local network.
This device is paired (%1$s). Sharing from other apps is active.
Not signed in yet. Sign in on the website and this device will be paired automatically.
Adds an icon with your brand logo if your server has one set.
Confirm adding it in your home screen dialog.
Your home screen does not support shortcuts.
The shortcut could not be created.
Open connected devices in the browser
Revokes this device, deletes sign-in and local data and opens the setup.
This device will be signed out and all local app data will be deleted.
Please open the VylarisCloud app and sign in first, then you can share files from other apps.
The upload could not be started.
%1$s: the file could not be read.
An unexpected error occurred while uploading.
